portfolioTitle: Keep the last impossible livestream online.
portfolioBody: Xuhuan is a one-thumb portrait shooter where seven digital performers fight an archive that edits every awkward moment into a perfect highlight.
portfolioDemoTitle: Try the core loop in your browser
portfolioDemoBody: Drag sideways, auto-fire, catch bright support notes, and trigger Rescue when Hype is full.
portfolioEngineeringBody: The Canvas game runs locally at 30 Hz for responsive input. Go validates bounded room results and owns legal transitions, rewards, unlocks, and durable progression.
portfolioTrustBody: Telegram initData is the only production player identity. PostgreSQL owns durable progress; Redis stores disposable rate-limit counters only. The public demo creates no account and writes no data.
portfolioStoryTitle: Eight short broadcasts, one growing backstage group
portfolioStoryBody: Each chapter begins with a familiar livestream mishap and turns it into a compact science-fiction mystery. The finale asks what is lost when an audience demands that performers never change.
portfolioFanNotice: Unofficial, non-commercial fan work and technical portfolio demonstration. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the referenced performers or platforms.
portfolioBuiltBy: Designed and engineered by Mingchen Liang
